capabilities: Draw and handwrite on an infinite canvas with pan, zoom, and pressure-sensitive pens
Insert, crop, rotate, and lock screenshots and photos on the board
Erase partial or whole strokes with per-gesture undo
Select, transform, align, and distribute items with rectangle and lasso selection
Save boards as .board files in the vault for cross-device viewing
extras: The manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Concurrent editing of one board is unsupported; parallel device changes are kept as conflict copies. Requires Obsidian 1.5.0+.
problem: Obsidian lacks a freehand drawing surface with stylus pressure support for annotating images and sketching on an unbounded canvas.
summary: Infinite canvas whiteboard for sketching, screenshot annotation, and Apple Pencil handwriting, saved as .board files that open across devices.
